_about: What the import check (tools/assets/asset_check.gd, tests/unit/tools/asset_import_test.gd) asks of every committed art asset under assets/. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §11 explains each field; the art repo's docs/contract.md and docs/godot.md are the source.

texture_compress_mode._about: compress/mode of a texture's .import per folder: 2 VRAM Compressed (3D), 0 Lossless (UI).

character._about: A GLB under assets/characters/. The bones are the art export's rig as measured (art docs/animations.md: CharacterArmature, 62 Ultimate Modular bones plus Toe.L and Toe.R); the contract v2 may replace them. The clips are the art MVP set's names (art tools/blender/anim_sets/mvp.toml) as Godot 4.7.2 imports them (a _Loop suffix dropped, the clip looping): the slice's list from prime-game-art#42, provisional, not a decision: #522 settles the clips it maps.

player_options._about: The importer's options on the AnimationPlayer node (_subresources nodes PATH:AnimationPlayer).
